cancellationObservationBoundary: Cancellation observed while adapter admission lock was held, with owned cleanup; no direct evidence that a Chronos kernel was already executing or interrupted.
cleanupObservationBoundary: Final cleanup.wallNs measures only final idempotent close. Actual container teardown occurred inside the active adapter-cancellation row and is included in its wallNs and full-run wallNs; do not treat final close wallNs as teardown duration.
historicalChanges: v3 uses explicitly owner-adopted cold readiness. Its unchanged-within-run flag does not reinterpret v1/v2 timing.
memoryObservationBoundary: Container cgroup memory is instantaneous at each response; process Linux ru_maxrss is lifetime peak. These measures have different accounting/timing scopes and are not interchangeable.
modelCpuScope: Prediction CPU time only; not import/load/container CPU or full deployment accounting.
